departure.title: Taxi request — south flow

radio.channel: Navy Corpus Ground · frequency per ATIS
radio.script: “Navy Corpus Ground, <callsign>, Sierra Run-ups, taxi information <ATIS>, VFR KINGS 4.”

departure.source: Course Rules Update Part 1, updated 26 Feb 2026, slide 26.

departure.title: Initial climb and Corpus Departure check-in
instructions: Climb to 500 ft MSL; begin turn at 300 ft (200 KIAS)
When directed by Tower, check in with Corpus Departure

radio.script: “Corpus Departure, <callsign>, 500 feet off Navy Corpus, KINGS 4.”

departure.source: User-provided Rusty Departure screenshot; radio-call example from COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §2(f), printed page 2-11.

departure.title: Fly Runway 13L heading to High Bridge
instructions: Fly heading 125° until High Bridge

departure.title: Abeam the High Bridge
instructions: Turn direct to Point Rusty
Climb to 2,500 ft MSL — 240 KIAS (climb at 180)

departure.title: State intentions / transition to Corpus Departure
instructions: Switch to Corpus Departure
State intentions / transition
departure.detail: The screenshot specifies the information to transmit but not a verbatim script; this wording is a practice template.

departure.title: Continue the RUSTY / KINGS 4 transition
instructions: Proceed from Point Rusty toward Bayside (≈360°)
Climb to 14,500 ft MSL for the applicable KINGS 4 entry
departure.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §2(f), printed page 2-11; Course Rules Update Part 1, updated 26 Feb 2026, slide 70.

kings-4.title: Coordinate with Houston Center
kings-4.leadIn: When directed by Corpus Christi Approach:
instructions: Obtain clearance before entering the MOA
kings-4.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §2(j), printed page 2-26.

kings-4.title: Claim Area 3 High
kings-4.leadIn: Before proceeding to the selected block:
instructions: Check whether the block is occupied; after responses, state the area you claim

radio.script: “99 KINGS 4, anybody working area 3 high?” After responses: “99 KINGS 4, <callsign> claims area 3 high.”

kings-4.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §2(j), printed page 2-26.

kings-4.title: Enter only when cleared and deconflicted
instructions: Maintain 14,500 ft MSL until established inside the MOA
kings-4.detail: Area 3 is a border block. Follow its current authorized entry procedure; this schematic does not show the boundary or track.
kings-4.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §2(i)–(j), printed pages 2-24–2-26; Course Rules Update Part 1, updated 26 Feb 2026, slides 70–71.

kings-4.title: Work the assigned block
instructions: Maintain a listening watch with Houston Center
Use the KNGP altimeter setting
KINGS 4 High block limits: 15,000–22,000 ft MSL (not an assigned altitude)
kings-4.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §2(i), printed page 2-24; Course Rules Update Part 1, updated 26 Feb 2026, slide 68.

goliad-nolf.title: Terminate with Houston Center
instructions: Terminate KINGS 4; state destination Goliad
goliad-nolf.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §2(k), printed page 2-28; CR2025 Summary of Changes, page 1.

goliad-nolf.title: State your departure on KINGS 4 Common
instructions: State departing area and Goliad intentions
goliad-nolf.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §2(k), printed page 2-28.

goliad-nolf.title: Exit KINGS 4 using the cleared procedure
instructions: Use the transition layer, Area 5 Low, or a coordinated climb/descent through an unoccupied area
goliad-nolf.detail: The actual exit method and path are not selected here.
goliad-nolf.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §2(k), printed page 2-28; Course Rules Update Part 1, updated 26 Feb 2026, slide 73.

goliad-nolf.title: Set up for Goliad
instructions: Below 9,000 ft MSL; switch to KNGT Common
Remain outside 5 NM or above 5,000 ft MSL from KNGT while setting up for initial
goliad-nolf.source: Course Rules Update Part 1, updated 26 Feb 2026, slide 74.

goliad-nolf.title: Check field status and runway in use
instructions: Confirm field status, runway, and traffic with the RDO
Pattern operations require both the RDO and Crash Crew
RDO hours: Mon–Fri, 0800 until RDO departure
goliad-nolf.source: Course Rules Update Part 2, updated 26 Feb 2026, slide 5.

goliad-nolf.title: Report the 4 NM initial
instructions: Two-way RDO contact is required before pattern entry
goliad-nolf.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §4(a)(6)–(7), printed page 2-30.

goliad-nolf.title: Follow the RDO sequence and pattern direction
instructions: Follow RDO sequencing and pattern direction
No acknowledgment by 2 NM: discontinue entry
The RDO does not issue landing clearance
goliad-nolf.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §4(a)(5)–(7), printed pages 2-29–2-30.

arrival.title: Depart Goliad toward Woodsboro
arrival.leadIn: After clear of pattern and break traffic:
instructions: Fly toward Woodsboro (≈140°)
Maintain 2,500 ft MSL · 240 KIAS
arrival.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §4(a)(12), printed pages 2-36–2-37.

arrival.title: Join the Goliad Arrival
instructions: Woodsboro → Bayside: 145°
Port Bay Bridge: 155°
Aransas Causeway: 150°
Maintain 2,500 ft MSL · 240 KIAS
Join the Northern Arrival
arrival.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §5(a)(6), printed page 2-60; Course Rules Update Part 2, updated 26 Feb 2026, slides 98–101.

arrival.title: Check in with Corpus Approach at Woodsboro
instructions: Report intentions to Corpus Approach
arrival.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §5(a)(6), printed page 2-60; Course Rules Update Part 2, updated 26 Feb 2026, slide 98.

arrival.title: Check in for the Northern Arrival
instructions: Check in with Corpus Approach
Maintain 1,500 ft MSL · 240 KIAS
arrival.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §5(a)(1), printed page 2-60; Course Rules Update Part 2, updated 26 Feb 2026, slide 102.

arrival.title: Continue toward Point Shamrock
instructions: Before the Causeway, descend to 1,000 ft MSL
At Point Shamrock, maintain 1,000 ft MSL · 240 KIAS
arrival.source: Course Rules Update Part 2, updated 26 Feb 2026, slides 102–103.

arrival.title: KNGP runway recovery not selected
arrival.prompt: This preview ends at Point Shamrock. No runway-specific recovery is shown because the KNGP arrival flow and recovery runway are not selected.
arrival.source: COMTRAWINGFOURINST 3710.14 VFR Course Rules Manual, 20 Feb 2025, Chapter 2, §5(a), printed pages 2-60–2-61.
